description: In a sunny churchyard in front of an old stone church tower with a clock, a young woman with a long braid, a fleece vest and leather gloves braces her feet and lets a thick rope slide through her hands, lowering a large green bronze bell from a pulley on a scaffold. The bell sinks slowly and settles onto a wooden cradle with sandbags on the grass. Among the gravestones other people watch, one man in black raises his hands, and coiled rope lies on a stone slab.
